63	func main() {
64		flag.Parse()
65	
66		if *filePath == "" || *repoName == "" {
67			fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Usage: analyze --file <path> --repo <name>")
68			os.Exit(1)
69		}

71		result, err := analyzeFile(*filePath, *repoName)

82	func analyzeFile(path, repo string) (*Result, error) {
83		fset := token.NewFileSet()
84		node, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, path, nil, parser.ParseComments)
85		if err != nil {
86			return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse error: %w", err)
87		}
88	
89		relPath := filepath.Base(path)
90		pkgName := node.Name.Name
91		if pkgName == "" {
92			pkgName = filepath.Dir(path)
93		}
94	
95		a := &analyzer{
96			repo:     repo,
97			path:     path,
98			relPath:  relPath,
99			pkgName:  pkgName,
100			fset:     fset,
101			symbols:  []Symbol{},
102			relns:    []Relationship{},
103		}
104	
105		ast.Walk(a, node)
106	
107		return &Result{
108			Symbols:       a.symbols,
109			Relationships: a.relns,
110		}, nil
111	}
112	
113	type analyzer struct {
114		repo    string
115		path    string
116		relPath string
117		pkgName string
118		fset    *token.FileSet
119	
120		currentStruct string
121		structFields  map[string][]string // struct name -> field names
122	
123		symbols []Symbol
124		relns   []Relationship
125	}
126	
127	func (a *analyzer) Visit(node ast.Node) ast.Visitor {
128		if node == nil {
129			return nil
130		}
131	
132		switch n := node.(type) {
133	
134		// ---- Type declarations (structs, interfaces) ----
135		case *ast.TypeSpec:
136			name := n.Name.Name
137			if name == "" {
138				return a
139			}
140	
141			switch t := n.Type.(type) {
142			case *ast.StructType:
143				sym := a.makeSymbol(name, "struct", n.Pos(), n.End())
144				a.detectGoConvention(&sym)
145				a.symbols = append(a.symbols, sym)
146				a.currentStruct = name
147	
148				// Extract fields as properties
149				for _, field := range t.Fields.List {
150					for _, fname := range field.Names {
151						fieldSym := a.makeSymbol(fname.Name, "property", field.Pos(), field.End())
152						fieldSym.ParentClass = name
153						fieldSym.Namespace = a.pkgName + "." + name
154						a.symbols = append(a.symbols, fieldSym)
155					}
156				}
157	
158			case *ast.InterfaceType:
159				sym := a.makeSymbol(name, "interface", n.Pos(), n.End())
160				a.symbols = append(a.symbols, sym)
161	
162				// Extract interface methods
163				for _, method := range t.Methods.List {
164					for _, mname := range method.Names {
165						methSym := a.makeSymbol(mname.Name, "method", method.Pos(), method.End())
166						methSym.ParentClass = name
167						methSym.Namespace = a.pkgName + "." + name
168						a.symbols = append(a.symbols, methSym)
169					}
170				}
171			}
172	
173		// ---- Function declarations ----
174		case *ast.FuncDecl:
175			name := n.Name.Name
176			if name == "" {
177				return a
178			}
179	
180			kind := "function"
181			parent := ""
182	
183			// Method with receiver
184			if n.Recv != nil && len(n.Recv.List) > 0 {
185				kind = "method"
186				recvType := a.typeToString(n.Recv.List[0].Type)
187				parent = recvType
188	
189				// Create relationship: receiver type CONTAINS this method
190				recvID := a.makeID(recvType)
191				methID := a.makeID(name)
192				a.relns = append(a.relns, Relationship{
193					ID:             fmt.Sprintf("%s|contains|%s", recvID, methID),
194					SourceSymbolID: recvID,
195					TargetSymbolID: methID,
196					Kind:           "contains",
197				})
198			}
199	
200			sig := a.funcSignature(n)
201			sym := a.makeSymbol(name, kind, n.Pos(), n.End())
202			sym.Signature = sig
203			sym.ParentClass = parent
204			if parent != "" {
205				sym.Namespace = a.pkgName + "." + parent
206			}
207			a.symbols = append(a.symbols, sym)
208	
209			// Extract calls within function body
210			if n.Body != nil {
211				a.extractCalls(n.Body, sym.ID)
212			}
213	
214		// ---- Import declarations ----
215		case *ast.ImportSpec:
216			importPath := strings.Trim(n.Path.Value, `"`)
217			if n.Name != nil {
218				importPath = n.Name.Name + "=" + importPath
219			}
220			sourceID := a.makeID("import:" + importPath)
221			targetID := a.makeID(importPath)
222			a.relns = append(a.relns, Relationship{
223				ID:             fmt.Sprintf("%s|imports|%s", sourceID, targetID),
224				SourceSymbolID: sourceID,
225				TargetSymbolID: targetID,
226				Kind:           "imports",
227				Metadata:       map[string]any{"importPath": importPath},
228			})
229		}
230	
231		return a
232	}

234	func (a *analyzer) extractCalls(body *ast.BlockStmt, callerID string) {
235		ast.Inspect(body, func(n ast.Node) bool {
236			call, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr)
237			if !ok {
238				return true
239			}
240	
241			var calleeName string
242			switch fun := call.Fun.(type) {
243			case *ast.Ident:
244				calleeName = fun.Name
245			case *ast.SelectorExpr:
246				calleeName = fun.Sel.Name
247			default:
248				return true
249			}
250	
251			if calleeName == "" || isBuiltin(calleeName) {
252				return true
253			}
254	
255			calleeID := a.makeID(calleeName)
256			a.relns = append(a.relns, Relationship{
257				ID:             fmt.Sprintf("%s|calls|%s", callerID, calleeID),
258				SourceSymbolID: callerID,
259				TargetSymbolID: calleeID,
260				Kind:           "calls",
261			})
262			return true
263		})
264	}
265	
266	func (a *analyzer) makeSymbol(name, kind string, pos, end token.Pos) Symbol {
267		ns := a.pkgName
268		startLine := a.fset.Position(pos).Line
269		endLine := a.fset.Position(end).Line
270		startCol := a.fset.Position(pos).Column
271		endCol := a.fset.Position(end).Column
272	
273		return Symbol{
274			ID:       a.makeID(name),
275			Name:     name,
276			Kind:     kind,
277			Language: "go",
278			Location: Location{
279				Repository:   a.repo,
280				RelativePath: a.relPath,
281				StartLine:    startLine,
282				EndLine:      endLine,
283				StartColumn:  startCol - 1,
284				EndColumn:    endCol - 1,
285			},
286			Namespace: ns,
287			Metadata:  map[string]any{"exported": ast.IsExported(name)},
288		}
289	}
290	
291	func (a *analyzer) makeID(name string) string {
292		return fmt.Sprintf("%s::%s::%s.%s", a.repo, a.relPath, a.pkgName, name)
293	}
294	
295	func (a *analyzer) detectGoConvention(sym *Symbol) {
296		name := sym.Name
297		isTest := strings.HasSuffix(a.relPath, "_test.go")
298	
299		switch {
300		case strings.HasSuffix(name, "Service"):
301			sym.Kind = "service"
302			sym.Metadata["detectedByConvention"] = true
303		case strings.HasSuffix(name, "Controller"):
304			sym.Kind = "controller"
305			sym.Metadata["detectedByConvention"] = true
306		case strings.HasSuffix(name, "Repository"):
307			sym.Kind = "repository"
308			sym.Metadata["detectedByConvention"] = true
309		case strings.HasSuffix(name, "Handler"):
310			sym.Kind = "controller"
311			sym.Metadata["detectedByConvention"] = true
312		case strings.HasSuffix(name, "Middleware"):
313			sym.Kind = "middleware"
314			sym.Metadata["detectedByConvention"] = true
315		case strings.HasSuffix(name, "DTO") || strings.HasSuffix(name, "Dto"):
316			sym.Kind = "dto"
317			sym.Metadata["detectedByConvention"] = true
318		case strings.HasSuffix(name, "Entity") || strings.HasSuffix(name, "Model"):
319			sym.Kind = "entity"
320			sym.Metadata["detectedByConvention"] = true
321		}
322	
323		if isTest {
324			sym.Kind = "test"
325			sym.Metadata["isTest"] = true
326		}
327	}
328	
329	func (a *analyzer) funcSignature(fn *ast.FuncDecl) string {
330		var b strings.Builder
331		b.WriteString("func ")
332		if fn.Recv != nil && len(fn.Recv.List) > 0 {
333			b.WriteString("(")
334			b.WriteString(a.typeToString(fn.Recv.List[0].Type))
335			b.WriteString(") ")
336		}
337		b.WriteString(fn.Name.Name)
338		b.WriteString("(")
339		for i, p := range fn.Type.Params.List {
340			if i > 0 {
341				b.WriteString(", ")
342			}
343			for j, name := range p.Names {
344				if j > 0 {
345					b.WriteString(", ")
346				}
347				b.WriteString(name.Name)
348			}
349			if len(p.Names) > 0 {
350				b.WriteString(" ")
351			}
352			b.WriteString(a.typeToString(p.Type))
353		}
354		b.WriteString(")")
355		if fn.Type.Results != nil && len(fn.Type.Results.List) > 0 {
356			b.WriteString(" ")
357			if len(fn.Type.Results.List) > 1 || len(fn.Type.Results.List[0].Names) > 0 {
358				b.WriteString("(")
359			}
360			for i, r := range fn.Type.Results.List {
361				if i > 0 {
362					b.WriteString(", ")
363				}
364				b.WriteString(a.typeToString(r.Type))
365			}
366			if len(fn.Type.Results.List) > 1 || len(fn.Type.Results.List[0].Names) > 0 {
367				b.WriteString(")")
368			}
369		}
370		return b.String()
371	}
372	
373	func (a *analyzer) typeToString(expr ast.Expr) string {
374		switch t := expr.(type) {
375		case *ast.Ident:
376			return t.Name
377		case *ast.StarExpr:
378			return "*" + a.typeToString(t.X)
379		case *ast.SelectorExpr:

1. **Protocol Structure**: The core protocol is defined in TypeScript interfaces
   - `Symbol` - universal representation of code elements
   - `Relationship` - directed edges between symbols
   - `AnalysisResult` - the output format containing symbols, relationships, errors, warnings

2. **Go Bridge Protocol Translation**:
   - Go analyzer outputs a JSON protocol matching `GoBridgeResult` interface
   - The JSON includes symbols with location data, relationships, errors/warnings

3. **Multi-language Adapter Pattern**:
   - `AbstractAnalyzer` - base class for all language analyzers
   - `LanguageAnalyzer` - interface that all analyzers must implement
   - Each language (Go, Python, PHP, C#, TypeScript, etc.) has its own analyzer
   - Analyzers normalize their raw output to the shared `Symbol`/`Relationship` types

4. **Factory Pattern**:
   - `AnalyzerFactory` - dispatches to language-specific analyzers by file extension
   - Maps file extensions and shebangs to languages
